methods.name: public boolean get(int index) throws ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException
methods.comment: *  Returns the indexed bit in this BitArray.

methods.comment: *  Sets the indexed bit in this BitArray.

methods.name: public int length()
methods.comment: * Returns the length of this BitArray.

methods.name: public byte[] toByteArray()
methods.comment:
* Returns a Byte array containing the contents of this BitArray.
     * The bit stored at index zero in this BitArray will be copied
     * into the most significant bit of the zeroth element of the
     * returned byte array.  The last byte of the returned byte array
     * will be contain zeros in any bits that do not have corresponding
     * bits in the BitArray.  (This matters only if the BitArray's size
     * is not a multiple of 8.)

methods.name: public boolean[] toBooleanArray()
methods.comment: * Return a boolean array with the same bit values a this BitArray.

methods.name: public int hashCode()
methods.comment:
* Returns a hash code value for this bit array.
     *
     * @return  a hash code value for this bit array.
